scope: Corollary 6.5 of the manuscript “Prescribed large-volume charges on threefolds with trivial canonical bundle” (preprints/Prescribed-large-volume-charges-on-threefolds-with-trivial-canonical-bundle-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 055 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ce978a67015704), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let E ∈ BH,B0+bH be finite-slope νA,b-semistable with νA,b(E) = 0 and |b| ≤ 1. Put B = B0 + bH and e = dB(E) − A|r(E)|. For r(E) ≥ 0, take P from (6.9) and put VP = H−1(P). For r(E) ≤ 0, use the decomposition (6.13) and put V = H−1(E). There is a constant C3, independent of E, b, such that h0 (P(j)) ≤ C3e for the positive decomposition, h0 (E(j)) ≤ C3e for the negative decomposition. (6.24) Moreover H0 (VP (j2)) = 0 in the positive decomposition, H0 (V (j2)) = 0 in the negative decomposition. (6.25)
